reason: Modifying PASS_MAX_DAYS in /etc/login.defs only affects future password expiration intervals for new password changes. It does not alter authentication mechanisms, SSH access, or critical services, and poses minimal risk of lockout when set to a reasonable value.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Setting an excessively low value could cause immediate password expiration for existing users; If the variable is left empty or misconfigured, the default may not meet organizational policy
